body: 画一张二乘二四格漫画，四格始终是同一只戴红项圈的小狗和同一间客厅。第一格主人穿外套离家；第二格小狗一本正经坐上沙发；第三格它把靠垫垒成堡垒；第四格门锁响起，小狗恢复乖巧坐姿，背后堡垒露出一角。柔和手绘风，每格边距一致，靠表情叙事，不加对白。

en.title: Pet home-alone comic strip
en.description: Four-panel comic preserves the red-collared dog and living room
en.body:
## How to use

Use the exact recorded prompt. No reference image is required. Changes to the prompt or inputs create an untested variant.

## Observed result

Four-panel comic preserves the red-collared dog and living room. Departure, sofa pose, cushion-building and innocent return pose are readable; final cushion fort is mostly collapsed.

## Source and generation

The source provides an original prompt; this production uses the separately recorded working prompt. [Source](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/image-prompting#turn-a-story-into-a-comic-strip). Source-post engagement does not measure this newly generated example.

Produced with the built-in GPT Image tool. The tool did not return an exact provider model ID; GPT Image 2.6 is the research topic, not a verified version claim for this output. All reference images used here were generated for this project.

zh-Hans.body:
## 使用方法

使用本次实际提交的提示词，无需参考图。修改提示词或底图后属于未验证的新变体。

## 观察结果

四格保留同一只红项圈小狗与客厅，展示主人离家、占据沙发、搭靠垫和恢复乖巧姿态。末格靠垫堡垒大部分已散开。

## 来源与生成

来源公开原提示词；本次使用单独记录的制作提示词。[来源](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/image-prompting#turn-a-story-into-a-comic-strip)。来源帖互动数不代表本次新生成案例的热度。

本例使用内置 GPT Image 工具生成。工具未返回精确模型 ID；GPT Image 2.6 是调研主题，不作为本次输出的已验证版本声明。使用的参考图均为本项目新生成。
